title: Driver Pay Schedule 1: Driver Rate Card by Ride Option
content:
This schedule sets the time-and-distance rates of driver pay under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** for a completed trip, by the ride option the trip was requested under. The schedule is the same at every Wayfare Pro status: Wayfare Pro Blue, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond and Diamond Elite.

## 1.1 Rate card (USD, every status)

| Ride option | Base | Per mile | Per minute | Minimum trip pay | Flat trip extra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Shared | 0.85 | 0.56 | 0.12 | 3.50 | 0.00 |
| Wayfare Standard | 1.00 | 0.66 | 0.16 | 3.75 | 0.00 |
| Wayfare Green | 1.00 | 0.66 | 0.16 | 3.75 | 0.50 (zero-emission extra) |
| Wayfare Comfort | 1.55 | 0.92 | 0.22 | 5.25 | 0.00 |
| Wayfare XL | 1.75 | 1.08 | 0.25 | 5.75 | 0.00 |
| Wayfare Black | 6.40 | 2.48 | 0.45 | 12.00 | 0.00 |
| Wayfare Black SUV | 12.00 | 3.08 | 0.56 | 20.00 | 0.00 |

The per-mile and per-minute rates apply to the trip's actual miles and actual minutes. The minimum trip pay is the smallest time-and-distance pay for one completed trip in that option. The flat trip extra is paid per completed trip in that option.

## 1.2 Busy-time share (every status)

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| Share of the busy-time multiplier passed to the driver on time-and-distance pay | 100% |

At a 100% share the busy-time multiplier recorded at the request acts on time-and-distance pay in full.

## 1.3 Rounding (every status)

Every computed earnings amount is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end of its computation. Intermediate figures are carried unrounded.

## 1.4 Hypothetical rate reading

For a hypothetical Wayfare Green trip of 5.0 actual miles and 14 actual minutes at a busy-time multiplier of 1.0, the rates above give a base of 1.00, mileage of 3.30 (0.66 per mile for 5.0 miles) and time of 2.24 (0.16 per minute for 14 minutes), a total of 6.54, which is above the Wayfare Green minimum of 3.75; the zero-emission extra of 0.50 is paid on top of that trip as its flat trip extra.
